question.text: In April 2020, WTI Oil Futures on Nymex turned negative primarily due to:

answer.text: Pandemic-induced lockdowns and the resulting demand-supply dynamics
A sudden increase in global oil production by OPEC
Cyber attack on oil trading systems
US government intervention to reduce oil prices

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook attributes the April 2020 negative WTI Oil Futures prices on Nymex to the pandemic-induced lockdowns and the resulting demand-supply dynamics in the crude oil market. The Trap: The other options are not supported by the source. The workbook does not attribute the move to OPEC production hikes, cyber attacks or US government intervention. Note: The explanation relies only on the pandemic-induced lockdowns and demand-supply dynamics described in the workbook.
